name: Ferienhaus Isabella
beschreibung:
Located in the traditional Haflinger village of Ebbs in Kufsteinerland, Ferienhaus Isabella offers wonderful conditions for a rejuvenating holiday. Its lovingly furnished apartments feature generous space, modern amenities, and balconies overlooking the mountains.

Nearby attractions include the renowned Fohlenhof stud farm, the zoo, and diverse hiking and climbing paths leading into the scenic Kaiser valley.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Isabella in Ebbs provides spacious comfort and a welcoming family atmosphere at the foot of the Zahmer Kaiser.
